text: Pelham Avenue is 7.5 metres wide and classified as a two lane local road, which runs in an east-west direction from Osler Street in the west to Laughton Avenue in the east. The current speed limit on this street is 30 km/h. I have received requests from residents on Pelham Avenue to install speed humps on Pelham Avenue, between Uxbridge Avenue and Laughton Avenue, in an effort to enhance pedestrian and school zone safety, as a result of the proximity to Charles-Sauriol Elementary School (55 Pelham Avenue) and the Pelham Avenue Parkette, located on the north side of Pelham Avenue, between Uxbridge and Laughton Avenue. Furthermore, residents are concerned with vehicle speeds and traffic infiltration on their street. With increased development and growth in the area and increased vehicular traffic, it is necessary to install speed humps for traffic calming purposes as shown on Drawing…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and approve the installation of traffic calming on Pelham Avenue, from Uxbridge Avenue and Laughton Avenue. 2. Requested the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Pelham Avenue, from Uxbridge Avenue to Laughton Avenue, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on Drawing EY18-061.DGN, dated May 2018.
